script.title: SUMMER CAMP SIGN-UP
script.scene_zh: 活動中心 · 報名夏令營
script.story_hook: Nina signs Zoe up for a week at camp.
script.intro_zh: 妮娜幫小孩報名參加一週的夏令營。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today we sign up for summer camp.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天我們來報名夏令營。
script.outro: Camp is booked and the bag is half-packed. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 營位報名成功，背包也收得差不多了。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the camp sign-up phrases together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起跟讀報名營隊時會用的句子。

script.youtube_title_en: "Welcome Aboard!" - Signing Up for Summer Camp and a Buddy Request
script.youtube_description:
夏天到了，想幫孩子用英文報營隊嗎？
社區活動中心的櫃台前，妮娜向輔導員詢問七月場次、玩水裝備、好友同組，還遇上刷卡機當機的小插曲，60 句連貫美語一次聽夠。
你會聽到：
🎧 詢問場次："What weeks do you have in July?"
🎧 確認裝備："What gear does she need?"
🎧 朋友同組："Do you want a buddy request?"
🎧 完成報名："You're all set. Questions? Call or text."
後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再跟著說。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
每天一段生活對話，英文住在耳朵裡。
喜歡請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，下一集見！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Want to sign your kid up for summer camp in English? Join Nina at the camp office as she asks about session dates, swim gear, a buddy request, and the bus stop. A card machine hiccup adds real-life practice with problem-solving phrases. These 60 lines of natural American English are perfect for daily listening. The second half is a sentence-by-sentence listen and repeat workout. Built for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen often and absorb. Subscribe for a new dialogue every week. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧夏令營報名英文｜問場次・備裝備・同組申請｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🎧60句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
想用英文幫孩子報夏令營，第一句話該怎麼說？
場次、名額、泳裝清單、朋友同組，都要問清楚，怎麼辦到？
這一集帶大家走進社區活動中心的營隊櫃台，看妮娜為八歲的佐伊報名七月營，從挑場次、問玩水規定，到刷卡當機改用線上付款。
你會聽到：
🎧 詢問場次："What weeks do you have in July?" 報名必問的第一句。
🎧 裝備清單："Swimsuit, towel, goggles, and sandals." 聽懂營隊要帶什麼。
🎧 朋友同組："Do you want a buddy request?" 孩子的貼心需求這樣提。
🎧 付款換管道："Can I finish paying online?" 出狀況時的彈性說法。
後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60 個句子先聽一遍、再跟著說一遍，從耳朵練到嘴巴。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。聽熟了，換你開口也不緊張。
祝每個小孩都有一個難忘的夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here about summer camp.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hiɹ əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmɚ kæmp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是來詢問夏令營的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You found us! Camp Owl's Creek.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju faʊnd ʌs kæmp aʊlz kriːk/
dialogue.zh: 您找對了！這裡是貓頭鷹溪夏令營。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. My daughter Zoe is eight now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈdɔːtɚ ˈzoʊi ɪz eɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，我的孩子佐伊今年八歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect age for our junior week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt eɪdʒ fɔɹ aʊɹ ˈdʒuniɚ wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 這個年齡剛好參加我們的小班週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What weeks do you have in July?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt wiːks du ju hæv ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 七月有哪幾週開放報名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: July seventh, and July twenty-first.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʊˈlaɪ ˈsɛvənθ ænd dʒʊˈlaɪ ˈtwɛnti fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 七月七號那週，還有七月二十一號那週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The twenty-first works. Is it open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtwɛnti fɜɹst wɜks ɪz ɪt ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 二十一號那週剛好，還有名額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see... seven spots left, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts si ˈsɛvən spɑts lɛft ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……其實只剩七個名額了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, we'll take one before it's gone!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wil teɪk wʌn bɪˈfɔɹ ɪts ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 欸，我們要先搶一個！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Done. Now, Zoe likes swimming?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dʌn naʊ ˈzoʊi laɪks ˈswɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，搞定！佐伊喜歡游泳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She loves it. What gear does she need?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lʌvz ɪt wʌt ɡiɹ dʌz ʃi nid/
dialogue.zh: 她超愛。她需要準備哪些裝備？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swimsuit, towel, goggles, and sandals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɪmˌsuːt ˈtaʊəl ˈɡɑɡəlz ænd ˈsændəlz/
dialogue.zh: 泳衣、毛巾、泳鏡還有涼鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you provide sunscreen?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju pɹəˈvaɪd ˈsʌnˌskɹin/
dialogue.zh: 營隊會提供防曬乳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, but bring your own bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du bʌt bɹɪŋ jɔɹ oʊn ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 營隊有，但請自備一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay! Um, when is the big water day?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm wɛn ɪz ðə bɪɡ ˈwɔːtɚ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好！嗯，那玩水的那天是哪一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our big lake day is Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹ bɪɡ leɪk deɪ ɪz ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 湖邊活動是安排在週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, Friday! We fly home that morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ wi flai hoʊm ðæt ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，週五我們要坐飛機回老家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bummer. You can skip lake day, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌmɚ ju kæn skɪp leɪk deɪ noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 可惜。湖邊那天可以請假，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would she miss a lot of fun?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ʃi mɪs ə lɑt əv fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 她會不會錯過很多好玩的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just that day; the pool days stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðæt deɪ ðə pul deɪz steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只有那天，其他泳池日都不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, okay. She'll still love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju oʊˈkeɪ ʃɪl stɪl lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呼，那還好。她一定會玩得很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, do you want a buddy request?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst du ju wɑnt ə ˈbʌdi ɹɪˈkwɛst/
dialogue.zh: 接下來，你要申請和好朋友同組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! My neighbor's kid, Max, is going.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈneɪbɚz kɪd mæks ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 要！鄰居家的馬克斯也報名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can put them in one group.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn pʊt ðɛm ɪn wʌn ɡɹup/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把他們排在同一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would save my whole summer, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd seɪv maɪ hoʊl ˈsʌmɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這樣我整個暑假都輕鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids settle faster with a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ˈsɛtəl ˈfæstɚ wɪð ə fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 有熟識的朋友，小孩會更快適應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how do I sign up?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ du aɪ saɪn ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那我要怎麼報名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A form online, then the deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fɔɹm ɑnˈlaɪn ðɛn ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先在線上填表格，然後付訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... I'm not great with websites.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪm nɑːt ɡɹeɪt wɪð ˈwɛbˌsaɪts/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……我不太會弄網站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do it right here together.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn du ɪt raɪt hiɹ təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以現在就在這裡一起填。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's so nice of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts soʊ naɪs əv ju/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你人真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, Zoe's birthday and shirt size?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊˈkeɪ ˈzoʊiz ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪ ænd ʃɜɹt saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好，佐伊的生日，還有衣服尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May ninth, and she wears a medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ naɪnθ ænd ʃi wɛɹz ə ˈmidɪəm/
dialogue.zh: 五月九號，她穿中號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any allergies or medicine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈælɚdʒiz ɔɹ ˈmɛdən/
dialogue.zh: 有過敏或在吃的藥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No allergies, but she fears bees.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈælɚdʒiz bʌt ʃi fɪrz biz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有過敏，但她怕蜜蜂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted. We keep medicine on file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd wi kip ˈmɛdən ɑn faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我們會登記好她的用藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you have a plan for everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ju hæv ə plæn fɔɹ ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你們什麼都先想好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost. Last one: the bus route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst læst wʌn ðə bʌs ɹut/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了。最後一項：巴士路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it stop near Oakwood Park?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt stɑp nɪɹ ˈoʊkwʊd pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 會停在橡樹公園附近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right by the playground gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt baɪ ðə ˈpleɪˌɡraʊnd ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會，就在遊樂場門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. What's the total with deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt wʌts ðə ˈtoʊtəl wɪð dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，連同訂金總共多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two-forty total, two hundred down today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɔɹti ˈtoʊtəl tu ˈhʌndɪd daʊn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 總價兩百四十，今天先付兩百訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay with a credit card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi peɪ wɪð ə ˈkɹɛdɪt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 可以用信用卡支付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, or check, or good old cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɔɹ tʃɛk ɔɹ ɡʊd oʊld kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，支票或現金也都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card's easy. Oh, do you take this card?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹdz ˈizɪ oʊ du ju teɪk ðɪs kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡最方便。請問你們收這種卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure do, the card machine is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ du ðə kɑɹd məˈʃin ɪz raɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 收的，刷卡機就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It didn't work! Hmm, the screen froze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈdɪdənt wɜɹk hʌm ðə skrin froʊz/
dialogue.zh: 刷不過！嗯，螢幕當機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry about that, it acts up on Mondays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt ɪt ækts ʌp ɑn ˈmʌnˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，這台星期一總是鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine. Can I finish paying online?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn kæn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈpeɪɪŋ ɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我可以在網上補付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll email you the link now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl ˈimɪl ju ðə lɪŋk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我現在把連結寄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works. Do I sign the form now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜks du aɪ saɪn ðə fɔɹm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊。那我現在就在表格上簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read it first, then sign at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɹid ɪt fɜɹst ðɛn saɪn æt ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 對，先看一遍，再簽在最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here? I sign right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ aɪ saɪn raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡？我就是在這裡簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. Welcome aboard, Zoe's mom!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈwɛlkəm əˈbɔɹd ˈzoʊiz mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 對了。歡迎加入，佐伊的媽媽！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! She'll be here July twenty-first.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ʃɪl bi hiɹ dʒʊˈlaɪ ˈtwɛnti fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 多謝！她七月二十一號會來參加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First day, drop-off is eight fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst deɪ ˈdɹɑp ˌɑf ɪz eɪt ˈfɪftin/
dialogue.zh: 第一天早上八點十五分送孩子到營地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, eight fifteen with the full bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑ ɪt eɪt ˈfɪftɪn wɪð ðə fʊl bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，八點十五分，背包收拾完整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set. Questions? Call or text.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɔl sɛt ˈkwɛstʃənz kɔɹ ɔɹ tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 全部搞定。有問題歡迎隨時打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for your patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fɔɹ jɔɹ ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 真的很謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Stay cool this summer!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm steɪ kul ðɪs ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！夏天記得防曬，保持涼快！
